scope: Read-only portable P6 Grid API/model/geometry/retention review of frozen v3. No native Grid, GUI, editing, accessibility, measured memory/performance or full P6 acceptance.

resolved_findings.initial: V1 source identity, column ID/title, active/anchor row keys, snapshot row/ref keys and cell text retained oversized backing through bounded substrings. Three unchanged reviewer tests failed against detached v1.
resolved_findings.resolution: V3 clones only accepted persistent strings; Snapshot clones one validated, budgeted row key shared across cells/ref and clones each validated, budgeted cell text. Column metadata and active keys are already owned. Empty strings detach. All three original regressions pass race20.

resolved_findings.initial: An opaque ref with *Grid indirectly retained borrowed Grid.source; cloning string payload alone did not make snapshots independent of domain lifetime.
resolved_findings.resolution: V3 ref retains only a nonzero-sized private identity token and detached key/column ID. Token has no source/Grid/interface/closure backpointer; exact-model and generation checks remain, no registry, and retained token prevents allocator ABA. Structural graph and identical foreign-model regression pass race20.
Spec/test correctly describes best-effort row anchor preservation subject to viewport extent clamping; exact anchor guarantee near end is not claimed.

reasoning: Owner-confined source methods and revision declarations remain explicit contracts; implementation validates only accessed rows/cells, indexed inverse consistency, complete stamp stability, generation exhaustion and prospective capacity before state publication.

Integer extent/product/width sums and viewport math are bounded; clipping partitions frozen/header/scrolling regions, overscan refs with empty clips refuse activation, failure/no-op retains valid ref generation.

Activation uses detached token + generation + key/column identity and current visibility. Self identity refuses copied Grid values. Source replacement preserves owned active/anchor keys only within matching source incarnation and clears them for new incarnation.
Existing Table/Tree source and tests are unchanged; qualified additive overlay compatibility is distinct from replacing/migrating those controls.

Callback-count workload demonstrates bounded queried/materialized cells for indexed procedural sources, not source heap usage, native frames, aggregate P6 completion or complexity of arbitrary caller implementations.
limitations: procedural indexed source; no stored dataset heap measurement
pointer graph/string backing tests are deterministic retention regressions, not GC memory benchmarks
source owner serialization and declared indexed access complexity are caller contracts
native input/layout/frame/GPU/AX/performance, variable heights, multi/all selection, editing, tree expansion and full P6 acceptance remain open
actions: Only detached source/test copies and review JSON were written under /private/tmp. No canonical or integration changes, Git, GUI, native settings, or Prism.
